summary: Pembina Pipeline Corp filed a Form 6-K with its Q2 2026 results press release, covering routine quarterly financial and operating highlights. The filing reports earnings, adjusted EBITDA, dividend declaration, and project progress including new growth projects and RFS IV service commencement. No special-situation transaction is disclosed. The 6-K also serves as the foreign private issuer's periodic report under Form 40-F. The dividend and project updates are ordinary course. No acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, or other special situation is indicated. This is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special-situation event.
